theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν' : Measure (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P n) (w : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (A R : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable τ ν' → Continuous w → (∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ A) → (∀ x, x ∉ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → w x = 0) → Integrable (fun x => ζ₀ (w x)) ν' → ENNReal.ofReal A * ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τ x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂ν' ≠ ∞ → |∫ x, τ x (w x) ∂ν' - ∫ x, ζ₀ (w x) ∂ν'| ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal A * ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τ x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂ν').toReal
